Samantha — great to meet yesterday and glad BlueForge is interested. High level: we operate two primary partner motions for ISVs — Referral and Resale.

- Referral: one-time placement or first-year credit (typically 8–12% of first-year ARR).
- Resale (ISV bundles Redwood into their offering and invoices customers): revenue-share that starts at 15% for self-serve/commercial partners and scales to ~25% for strategic partners with committed volume / co-selling.

Lead registration: we use a short online form + deal registration in HubSpot. Once registered, deals are protected for 180 days (standard) provided there is a mutual action plan and an intro email thread. We require evidence of origin for inbound leads (email thread, MQL exports, or signed LOI).

I attached a short draft (BlueForge_Draft_revshare_v1.pdf) with the baseline terms we typically offer. Camila, Ben — can you review the rates and registration language?

Next step suggestion: if those bands look ok, we run a short SOW that covers integration support and margin guarantees for the first 12 months.

Samantha — quick legal/sales ops note:

- The 15–25% band is our guideline. For resale deals where Redwood invoices directly and BlueForge is acting as a reseller (i.e., resale), we usually net settle monthly with a baseline 20% split for year one for new customers that are a result of partner-led efforts.
- Referral payouts are typically paid on invoice collections and paid out within 45 days after cash receipt.
- Lead proofing: we accept CRM exports, signed LOIs, or a minimum of two dated email exchanges showing the opportunity and contact. Screenshots alone are not sufficient.

Samantha, if you want a firm commitment on a first-year 20% revshare for BlueForge-sourced deals, we can include that in the reseller amendment and put a 6-month review clause.
